summary.adminHistoricalDefaultCache: 24h stale-known evidence cache with explicit refresh bypass
estimatedCallReductionNotes: BigQuery export trigger now exits before claim transaction unless the daily window is due.
BigQuery export writes bounded watermark batches instead of only the triggering event row.
Anonymous ingest preserves priority event storage while deferring user-index materialization.
Realtime admin analytics summary cadence moved from 1 minute to 5 minutes.
Admin historical analytics defaults to stale-known cache and labels source freshness.
Admin Debug now has a short private hot-cache path and bounded queue heartbeat reads.

fixesApplied.detail: Added pre-transaction daily guard, watermark window helper, bounded batch export, readiness failure TTL, and single status update per export window.
Removed synchronous user tracking index materialization from anonymous ingest response path and made invalid JSON/payload failures non-retryable 4xx.
Moved non-critical realtime summary schedule from one minute to five minutes and added an in-function cadence no-op guard.
Default route cache now follows the 24h non-priority evidence TTL, supports explicit admin refresh, and labels cache age/source freshness.
Added a short private hot-cache path and a lazy-load plan marker. Full domain splitting is deferred because the current Admin Debug client expects the combined payload.
Default heartbeat listing now orders by updatedAt and limits to latest 25 records.

deferredFindings.reason: The route currently feeds a broad Admin Debug payload. Splitting sections safely requires matching client fetch changes and route contract tests; this pass added a short hot cache and exact lazy-load plan instead of risking missing debug truth fields.
deferredFindings.nextStep: Create section routes for creator operations, orchestration evidence, analytics truth drilldowns, and package/dependency evidence, then update Admin Debug client tabs to fetch those lazily.

deferredFindings.reason: This pass scoped the anonymous ingest route requested in the hot-path audit. Identified ingest still has a materializer call and should be reviewed in a separate focused pass to avoid changing authenticated tracking semantics too broadly.
deferredFindings.nextStep: Apply the same deferred materialization policy to /api/analytics/ingest-identified after confirming known-user index freshness requirements.

costSavingsModel.model: Per-event claim transaction removed for not-due windows; only due windows attempt a transaction and export bounded batches.
costSavingsModel.estimatedReduction: up to 99% fewer claim transactions in the export lane when event volume is higher than one event per day

costSavingsModel.model: Watermark batches export up to 500 rows per due window instead of one triggering row.
costSavingsModel.estimatedReduction: 95-99% fewer function starts per exported batch once scheduled export is promoted

costSavingsModel.model: Hot route no longer scans up to 500 behavioral facts or writes user index documents before responding.
costSavingsModel.estimatedReduction: 20-60% lower Cloud Run CPU and Firestore read/write work for anonymous ingest requests

costSavingsModel.model: Permanent invalid JSON/payload failures return non-retryable 400/422 instead of falling through to retryable 503.
costSavingsModel.estimatedReduction: 50-90% fewer retry-loop requests for malformed analytics clients

costSavingsModel.model: Cadence moved from 1 minute to 5 minutes.
Default historical route cache moved from 45 seconds to 24 hours for non-priority evidence.
costSavingsModel.estimatedReduction: up to 99.9% fewer cold rebuilds for repeated unchanged admin historical reads

costSavingsModel.model: Admin Debug full payload is cached for 30 seconds after successful load.
costSavingsModel.estimatedReduction: high repeated-refresh savings during operator sessions; first-load domain split remains deferred

costSavingsModel.model: Default heartbeat listing reads latest 25 instead of full collection.
costSavingsModel.estimatedReduction: 80-99% fewer heartbeat reads as heartbeat history grows

nextFixOrder: Split Admin Debug creator/orchestration/analytics truth domains into lazy section routes with client-side tab fetches.
Move identified ingest user tracking materialization out of the authenticated hot path after known-user freshness review.
Export the scheduled BigQuery raw-events function from the Functions index in a deployment-scoped pass if owner approves replacing the event trigger.
